notes.title: Playtest Patch #5
notes.notes:
Meet Global Chat!

Now, you will be able to communicate with players in chat, see their real-time statuses such as: Looking for a fight or is in a fight.

Please follow the rules of communication: Do not insult each other and do not spam various links, otherwise you will be blocked.
Chat is in test mode, will be updated and finalized.

notes.title: Playtest Patch #4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297162/03a4858cb178832a3773be54cd54fe086219eb0b.png“Wishing Portal” is now in the Game!

Players can now access the functionality to obtain various assets in the game, such as: Avatars with different in-game bonuses.

To use the portal, you need to click the corresponding button in the main lobby menu, after which the "Wishing Portal" management interface will be available, allowing you to choose loot boxes that you want to purchase with MBGR, the in-game currency. Currently, only one loot box is available, which contains one random avatar.

Note: The price of each loot box is dynamic and changes in real-time; loot boxes may become slightly cheaper or slightly more expensive (depending on various factors and calculated automatically on the game server side).

Mandatory: Before activating the portal, make a wish, and the portal might grant you what you need :) 

Fixes and Improvements:

 Support for ultra-wide monitors.
 Information in the game UI when clicking on any tower (except for monster waves and mercenaries).
 Various minor bug fixes.


Information: This is a significant game update, and various bugs may occur, so please report them to us on our Discord or on the website in the Bugs section (submit a ticket).

notes.title: Playtest Patch #3
notes.notes:
Refinement of the game interface.


 Game interface functionality has been added for the main base - now when you click on your base or the opponent's base (the opponent's base is available only during the active phase of the round), you can see the base statistics: HP (current and maximum health), DPS (damage per second) and other characteristics. This will help players better understand how to interact with base upgrades.

 Every wave up to and including wave 9, the base gets “Auto Boost Stats” to have adequate health and damage stats for each wave. Base upgrades are now counted from the base characteristic value and added to the current one.


Fixes:
The game has received various interfacing fixes, minor bugs and glitches have been fixed, such as for example were with the base upgrade panel when it would randomly appear or not disappear when there was no mouse cursor on this element.

notes.title: Playtest Patch #2
notes.notes:
Major game balance update.
Players now do not get the gold bonus for enhanced waves (after wave 9).
Now players do not get gold for killing reinforced wave monsters and mercenaries in those waves (after wave 9).
Now gameplay after the 9th wave is tied to the income from crystals - the income from them every wave is converted into gold.
Tip: Build first defense towers, then start accumulating workers who mine crystals, as after the 9th wave it will be your main income..
P.S. We found the game in the new gameplay more interesting, so we are waiting for your feedback!

Changes:

[olist]
 HP and damage of all enemy waves have been changed, now the waves are more balanced.
 Reinforced waves (after the 9th wave): The enhancement formula has been changed, the initial strength increase is minimal and increases smoothly.
[/olist]

Corrections:

[olist]
 Fixed getting player progress when entering the main lobby menu (experience, tokens).
 Fixed various minor interface flaws.
[/olist]

notes.title: Playtest Patch #1
notes.notes:
Major balance update that affects all towers including monster waves (except mercenaries).

Changes:
[olist]
 The HP and Damage of all towers have been increased, so that Avatars (Common 1%) give more obvious bonuses.
 Enhanced Waves (after wave 9): The reinforcement formula has been tweaked to make subsequent waves stronger.
[/olist]

Corrections:
[olist]
 The problem with Avatars has been fixed, now they are installed and displayed correctly.
 The function of getting player progress when entering the main lobby menu (experience, tokens) has been fixed.
 Various minor interface flaws have been fixed.
[/olist]
